```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Part A

Building Data Frame

```{r}
data = data.frame(
  outcome = c(6, 7, 8, 8, 9, 10,
              8, 9, 10, 10, 11, 12,
              12, 13, 14, 14, 15, 16),
  group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 6))
)
```

ANOVA

```{r}
fit <- aov(outcome ~ group,data=data)
print(summary(fit))
groups <- split(data$outcome,data$group)
n <- lengths(groups); means <- sapply(groups,mean)
N <- sum(n); k <- length(n)
ssw <- sum(residuals(fit)^2)
mse <- ssw/(N-k)
grand <- mean(data$outcome)
ssb <- sum(n * (means - grand)^2)
print(c(MSE = mse, SSB = ssb, SSW = ssw))
```
